items.sentence: The young elephant used its trunk to sweep the dirty porch.
She stopped to glance at the gleaming toy in the window.
Today, those yellow boots match the color of the raincoat perfectly.
The small mice carried tiny furniture into their comfortable tree house.
Before building the shelf, the robot read a thick manual.
Today, the old coin has great value to the young collector.
A large pot of soup bubbled gently on the stove.
The red fox filled a grocery bag with apples and bread.
A striped tiger cub rolled cheerfully across the soft grass.
While ideas fill his mind, a student holds a puzzle.
